Camarda Financial Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 12.08% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Camarda Financial Advisors Llc sold 2,232 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,248 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.75M, down from 18,480 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Camarda Financial Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $924.93B market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
